description: This file defines a route layout component for a Qwik-based web application. It sets cache control headers and provides a layout component that renders a main section with a slot for nested content.

methods.name: onGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests for the route, setting cache control headers to optimize caching behavior.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Exports a Qwik component that renders a main element with a Slot for nested routes or content.
